compared.claim: doi:10.5802/ahl.16:prop:RPExtRoelcke, the statement at lines 571-573 that the same proof block at lines 575-577 also proves
compared.difference: The two statements share one proof block but are not interderivable in the way that would make one a restatement of the other: this card's statement is the membership criterion for a colouring at a point of the compactification given by one determining joint embedding, while the adjacent statement is the equivalence between the Ramsey property for the whole class at that point and a transfer condition quantified over all finite substructures and all joint embeddings of the stated form. Each is a genuine consequence used on its own by the article, so the counted unit is the membership criterion and the adjacent statement is left as a navigation pointer.
